BlueSky Express recorded an on-time arrival rate of 98 percent this quarter.

policies.text: Maritime charter endorsement requires a vessel safety inspection score of at least 90 points annually.
Premier punctuality distinction requires an on-time arrival rate of 95 percent or higher this quarter.
High-capacity carrier classification is granted when a firm maintains a fleet size of at least 10 coaches.
Freight forwarding certification is granted to air cargo handlers maintaining a minimum warehouse storage area of 50,000 square feet.
An operator with high-capacity carrier classification is chosen as preferred event transport.
